text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The best way t'get in shape is by rethink'n your diet. If I eat some more wild veggies, I should be okay!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Although… they're not 'xactly popp'n outta the ground everywhere like they are back home…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, that's no reason t'give up! I just gotta look harder!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay! I've found some! Time t'get pick'n! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I betcha there's a bunch more 'round here too… Okay! The search is on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew. Well, turns out there's plenty out there if you go look'n for 'em. And now I'm ready t'rustle up some wild-veggie grub!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Oop! The day's gone and ended! I gotta hurry back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following her wild veggie harvest, Yukino Bijin cooks up some healthy dishes and gets her health back in order!
